final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN ('School building', 'Office building')
  AND surface_area >= 146
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 4.0
  AND energy_score_plant >= 3
  AND energy_score_envelope >= 1
  AND mobility >= 47.1
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
